# INDIA_POLICY

Only India-based openings are eligible for the accepted set.

## Eligible

- Any location that names India or an Indian city/region, e.g. India, Bengaluru /
  Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Gurgaon / Gurugram,
  Noida, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Indore, Kochi, Coimbatore, Chandigarh,
  Thiruvananthapuram, Mysuru, Nagpur, Visakhapatnam, Bhubaneswar, Gandhinagar.
- **Remote – India** (remote roles explicitly scoped to India).
- A multi-location posting is eligible **only** when India is explicitly one of
  the named locations.

## Not eligible (must be rejected)

- Any purely foreign location (US, UK, EU, Canada, Australia, Singapore,
  Philippines, UAE, etc.).
- "Remote" with no country, "Multiple locations" with no India, or any location
  that cannot be confirmed as India — **unknown is rejected**, never assumed.

Deterministic Python re-derives this from the captured location string; a foreign
or unknown location never enters the accepted set.
